core.accounts.detail.reason_superuser: A superuser account can only be changed from the server.

core.accounts.detail.enable_body: The person can sign in again.

core.accounts.setting.signup.title: Who can sign up
core.accounts.setting.signup.description: Whether anyone can create an account or only people who were invited.
core.accounts.setting.session_lifetime.t: How long people stay signed in
core.accounts.setting.session_lifetime.d: After this long a person has to sign in again. From 1 hour to 365 days.
core.accounts.setting.superuser_session_: How long a superuser stays signed in
The break-glass superuser signs in again after this long. From 10 minutes to 24 hours.
core.accounts.setting.password_min_lengt: The fewest characters a new password may have. From 12 to 128.
core.accounts.setting.login_failure_limi: How many wrong passwords for one e-mail address are allowed within the window below before sign-in pauses. From 3 to 100.
core.accounts.setting.client_failure_lim: Wrong passwords from one device or network
The same, counted per device or network address. Many people share one address at a venue, so keep it at least as high as the limit above. From 10 to 1000.
core.accounts.setting.login_failure_wind: How long failed sign-ins are counted
Failed sign-ins and password-reset requests older than this are forgotten. From 1 minute to 24 hours.
core.accounts.signin.reset_done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
core.accounts.reset.title: Reset your password
core.accounts.reset.request.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
core.accounts.reset.request.sent: If an account exists for that address, an e-mail is on its way.
core.accounts.reset.request.sent_hint: The link works once, and only for a short time. If nothing arrives, check your spam folder.
core.accounts.reset.request.not_configur: Password reset by e-mail isn't set up here. Ask an administrator for a temporary password.
core.accounts.reset.complete.title: Choose a new password
core.accounts.reset.complete.mismatch: The two passwords aren't the same.
core.accounts.reset.complete.invalid: This link isn't valid. It may already have been used, or a newer link may have replaced it.
core.accounts.setting.password_reset_lif: How long a password-reset link works
After this long the link in the e-mail stops working and the person asks again. From 10 minutes to 24 hours.
core.accounts.setting.password_reset_cli: Password-reset requests from one device or network

How many password-reset e-mails may be requested from one device or network address within the sign-in window above. Many people share one address at a venue, so keep it at least as high as the per-address limit below. From 5 to 1000.
core.accounts.setting.password_reset_add: Password-reset requests for one e-mail address
How many password-reset e-mails may be requested for one e-mail address within the sign-in window above, whether or not an account exists for it. From 1 to 100.
core.accounts.setting.password_reset_coo: After a reset e-mail is sent, further requests for that account send nothing until this long has passed; the earlier link keeps working. 0 turns the pause off. Up to 1 hour, and never longer than the link lifetime above.
